verdict.rationale: Lium documents several keyless public endpoints for checking prices and availability before spending: a one-call JSON feed of every rentable GPU node, a pricing CSV feed, a public availability WebSocket, and an MCP server that returns live GPU prices and availability. Its llms.txt tells agents to read public prices with no account, and a probe confirmed llms.txt is live. missing for 10: independent or hands-on confirmation that the nodes feed actually returns live pricing and availability data.

support.subject: As an AI agent, I can query the GPU catalog with live pricing and availability from a public or documented endpoint before committing any spend
